name: Launch & Bind
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Fast, theme-aware app launcher for Omarchy: type to find any app, give it or its actions (e.g. New Incognito Window) a global shortcut, and open widgets, plugins and tray apps from a second list, where widgets can also be put into or taken out of the bar. See who owns every key, rebind it in one click, or use two-step shortcuts.
